notes.title: FIXES AND UPDATES - v1.1
notes.content:
[b]NEW & UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] New music added.
[*] New content added for the upcoming Halloween themed levels and Live Challenges.
[*] Added Hole name and Area text during the Intro Camera sequence.
[*] Added winner celebration at the end of the Championship in multiplayer mode.
[*] Unlocking all holes for Practice based on the Live Challenges completed.
[*] Added Chroma support (PC only)
[*] Several hole tweaks to ground some floating background objects.
[*] Several intro camera tweaks for many levels.
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Several hole fixes to prevent some issues that can cause infinite scoring.
[*] Several hole fixes to prevent some issues that can cause the ball to be stuck between two bodies.
[*] Dynamic obstacles reset correctly after returning to Tee in multiplayer mode.
[*] Small localisation fixes.
[*] Several Free Camera collision fixes and Out-of-Bounds places in several levels.
[/list]

notes.title: QUICK FIXES AND UPDATES - v1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]NEW & UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added score card to the pause menu in Championship mode.
[*] Added a medal amount to the Ball Unlock widget.
[*] After 48 Hour Challenge has ended, switch the panel button to do an online check instead.
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Returning to the Tee from Pause now stops the Out of Play sequence.
[*] Fixes to Free Cam to safely handle temporarily returning to Tethered during teleportation.
[*] Fixes to general Leaderboards display inconsistencies.
[*] Played Championship button outline highlight fix.
[*] Kitchen Free Camera Collision fixes.
[*] Garage Free Camera Collision fixes.
[*] "Round-Or-Bouts" level translucency through camera fixes and restored difficult-but-possible Albatross.
[*] Saw Blade in "Bricks 'n' Sticks" level fixed - stopping instant pop-up.
[*] "Drawbridges" level scene fixes.
[*] Potential fade screen not playing correctly when going to the Main Menu.
[*] Potential fade screens not playing correctly during gameplay.
[*] Fixes to gamepad stick sensitivity on the Ball Selection screen.
[/list]
